instruction: Unfollow all the artists who have not sung even a single song I have liked on Spotify.
notes: Single-app (spotify) task. The real set of followed artists is unknown a priori, so representative artist objects are declared as domain constants (so supervisor-complete-task can state the exact goal conjunction without quantifiers): two followed artists with no liked song (must be unfollowed) and one followed artist with a liked song (must remain followed). Static facts (followed ?ar) / (has-liked-song ?ar) describe the world; the knowledge flags (known-following-artists) and (known-liked-songs), produced by show_following_artists and show_liked_songs, gate the unfollow action, mirroring the data flow of the reference solution. Both listing APIs should be paginated at runtime (page_index 0..n) but are modeled as a single action each. Login username comes from supervisor.show_profile (email) and the password from supervisor.show_account_passwords. No answer is required, so supervisor-complete-task takes no parameters; it is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
